collection.title: Daewoo Lanos 1997 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Dsewoo Lanos Hatchback 1997 to 2003 requires a 19" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
